recovery_credit_policy: Every plasma joule is debited on source injection. Only energy collected from radiated bubble sound and delivered by the modeled distributed receiver and power manager is credited. No potential or pending plasma energy is counted as recovered.

cumulative_accounting.model_warning: uncalibrated optimistic distributed acoustic collector around spherical bubble; no coupled shell back-action, plasma MHD, acoustic FEM, resolved shocks or measured energy return
cumulative_accounting.stage: externally funded plasma heating + finite-energy compression and cosine acoustic wave train
cumulative_accounting.recovery_limit_reason: The spherical receiver can improve capture of radiated sound, not exceed the emitted acoustics or offset upstream converter dissipation. Ideal pulse recovery remains bounded by converter output.

cumulative_break_even_policy: Net break-even occurs only when total useful delivery plus net storage change exceeds all historical source energy. Idle accumulation cannot erase proportional converter losses. Ideal 100% pulse recapture is an upper bound, not a physical prediction.
